sentences.text: The evidence does not specify a late payment fee amount for credit card dues in the policy materials provided.
The only directly relevant policy text says charges for delayed payment, if any, are to be applied on the overdue amount and not on the entire loan amount, but it does not set a fee level.
The credit card entries shown in the directions are fraud-liability tables and do not state a late payment fee for credit card dues.

missing.searched: Searched the cited UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions provisions on delayed payment charges and the credit card tables, but no fee amount was found.
